mapper.select: SELECT br.behavior_code, bt.label AS behavior_label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY br.behavior_code, bt.label ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT br.id AS recordId, br.class_record_id AS classRecordId, br.behavior_code AS behaviorCode, bt.label AS behaviorLabel, DATE_FORMAT(br.occurred_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS occurredAt, br.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, bst.label AS stageLabel, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS( '；', NULLIF(TRIM(br.antecedent_text), ''), ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN tag.tag_code = 'OTHER' THEN CONCAT(option_row.label, '：', tag.custom_text) ELSE option_row.label END ORDER BY group_row.display_order, option_row.display_order SEPARATOR '；' ) FROM behavior_record_abc_tag tag JOIN abc_tag_option option_row ON option_row.dimension = tag.dimension AND option_row.code = tag.tag_code JOIN abc_tag_group group_row ON group_row.dimension = option_row.dimension AND group_row.code = option_row.group_code WHERE tag.behavior_record_id = br.id AND tag.dimension = 'ANTECEDENT' ) ), '') AS antecedentText, br.behavior_description AS behaviorDescription, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS( '；', NULLIF(TRIM(br.consequence_text), ''), ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN tag.tag_code = 'OTHER' THEN CONCAT(option_row.label, '：', tag.custom_text) ELSE option_row.label END ORDER BY group_row.display_order, option_row.display_order SEPARATOR '；' ) FROM behavior_record_abc_tag tag JOIN abc_tag_option option_row ON option_row.dimension = tag.dimension AND option_row.code = tag.tag_code JOIN abc_tag_group group_row ON group_row.dimension = option_row.dimension AND group_row.code = option_row.group_code WHERE tag.behavior_record_id = br.id AND tag.dimension = 'CONSEQUENCE' ) ), '') AS consequenceText, bft.label AS functionLabel, br.assistance_result_text AS assistanceResultText, ct.label AS courseLabel, et.label AS environmentLabel, cr.record_date AS recordDate FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code JOIN course_type ct ON ct.code = cr.course_code JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = cr.environment_code LEFT JOIN behavior_stage_type bst ON bst.code = br.stage_code LEFT JOIN behavior_function_type bft ON bft.code = br.function_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND br.detail_saved = TRUE ORDER BY br.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 200
